extra.final_summary:
Average bill length (mm) for Adelie penguins by island: Biscoe 37.25, Dream 37.47, Torgersen 39.21 (24 Adelie rows used).

Data problems found and fixed (both approved):
1. 2 exact duplicate rows (rows 9 and 22) removed — they would have double-counted penguins in the averages.
2. Island label misspellings normalized per the rules file: "Dram" → "Dream" (2 rows) and "Torgerson" → "Torgersen" (1 row), so all Adelie rows group under the correct islands.

No other issues affected the question: bill_length_mm had no missing values and all values were within the rules range (30–60 mm), and species labels were clean.
